question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is __**earliest**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **earliest **is the superlative degree of adjective **early**.
 
• The word **early **means done before expected time.

Example : The teacher came early </strong
